candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on POST /v1/authorizations, causing order to fail and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502. Traces show payment 503 preceding order 502 and checkout 502 across multiple correlation IDs; inventory reservations succeed (200).
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side logs or metrics admitted; root cause within payment (config, saturation, dependency) not established.

report.explanation: Gateway checkout 502s trace to payment returning 503 on authorizations; order then fails and gateway surfaces 502. Inventory path is healthy. Payment-side cause is unconfirmed, so the bounded candidate is the failing downstream HTTP error path.
missing_evidence: Payment dependency health (postgresql) and resource saturation metrics
